description: This Java class 'SensorSnifferPane' provides a GUI component for visualizing sensor data in real-time, including chart rendering, controls for pausing, clearing, saving images, and handling incoming data messages.

classes.name: SensorSnifferPane
classes.description: Main GUI component for sensor data visualization with controls and real-time updates.

methods.name: SensorSnifferPane
methods.description: Constructor initializing the panel with configuration and setting up UI components and listeners.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Sets the paused state and updates the pause button label.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the chart data and resets min/max values.

methods.name: processValues
methods.description: Calculates min/max X and Y values from the data for chart scaling.

methods.name: getPanel
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel containing the UI.

methods.name: getTabSelectedListener
methods.description: Returns an ActionListener that focuses the command input when tab is selected.

inner_classes.name: SensorSnifferCanvas
inner_classes.description: Custom Swing component for rendering the sensor data chart.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Draws the chart and axis labels.

static_methods.name: unpackValues
static_methods.description: Parses a string message into key-value pairs and populates the data map.
